steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX functionality required for event creation.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to Auction and choose the traffic-light strategy.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Set the first line item's delivery location.
Confirm the requested delivery location was applied.
Complete the remaining required pricing-sheet fields.
Commit a 30-minute schedule starting now.
Invite three QA vendors for the three bids.
Publish the configured auction.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor 1's bid at 100.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor 2's bid at 95.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor 3's bid at 120.
Confirm the third vendor bid was accepted.
Open the available QA vendor portal session for the vendor-side observation.
Open the auction's pricing round in the vendor portal.
Confirm the vendor portal reflects a submitted bid.
Return to the buyer console to inspect responses.
Confirm the buyer sees all three direct vendor responses and full participation.
